# Outer dimensions
outer_x = 220  # mm
outer_y = 300  # mm
outer_z = 160  # mm

# Wall thickness and bottom thickness
wall_thickness = 8  # mm
bottom_thickness = 12  # mm

# Inner dimensions (for the hollow part to subtract)
inner_x = outer_x - 2 * wall_thickness  # 220 - 16 = 204 mm
inner_y = outer_y - 2 * wall_thickness  # 300 - 16 = 284 mm
inner_z = outer_z - bottom_thickness     # 160 - 12 = 148 mm (height from bottom to top)

# Position of inner block (offset by wall thickness in x and y, bottom thickness in z)
inner_x_pos = wall_thickness  # 8 mm
inner_y_pos = wall_thickness  # 8 mm
inner_z_pos = bottom_thickness  # 12 mm

print(f"Outer block dimensions: {outer_x} x {outer_y} x {outer_z} mm")
print(f"Inner block dimensions: {inner_x} x {inner_y} x {inner_z} mm")
print(f"Inner block position: ({inner_x_pos}, {inner_y_pos}, {inner_z_pos})")
